items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: if it had been me, Benny Goodman wouldn't be broadcasting the same book I got.

ctx.x: Let me ask you something about Fletcher. It's sometimes said that he was not a strong leader and that he was not a good businessman, and he sort of let the band go to pieces under him. Did he take care of business while you were with him?

Well, how do you mean that, did he take care of business? A lot of things happened that shouldn't have happened; I'll just put it to you like this. For instance, like, if it had been me, Benny Goodman wouldn't be broadcasting the same book I got. You understand what I mean?
